_comment: modules: generated by 'tools/qtci.py import-qt5' from qt5.git tag v6.12.0. The SHAs are the module commits that the tag records.

qtmultimedia._installs: The FFmpeg backend (the patches of this repository change it). Configure leaves it out without an error if it cannot use FFmpeg.

qtdoc._installs_nothing: The build of qtdoc installs no files (its examples and docs come from other steps), so the install check accepts an empty install.

qtwebview._installs_if: Path patterns that the install must add when the named module is built: the QtWebEngine backend plugin.

qtwebengine._comment: Not a qt5.git submodule in 6.12, and has no v6.12.0 tag. This commit is the tip of the 6.12 branch that opensource-qtmake6120-msvc2022-qtwebengine.bat uses.
qtwebengine._used_by: Modules that have an optional QtWebEngine backend. They are built after QtWebEngine, and by the same job when QtWebEngine runs on a separate runner.
qtwebengine._cmake_args: For all kits. Forcing the features on makes configure fail if a requirement is missing, instead of skipping the module.
qtwebengine._installs: Path patterns (relative to the prefix) that the install must add. The item fails if one matches nothing.
qtwebengine._third_party_licenses: Chromium records its third-party code in README.chromium and LICENSE files, not in qt_attribution.json. The build copies every license file under these directories into the kit.

toolchains._ffmpeg: Every kit builds this FFmpeg (tools/build-ffmpeg.sh), and the Build FFmpeg workflow releases it for the kits in release. configure.common is the option list of Qt (coin/provisioning/common/shared/ffmpeg_config_options.txt in qt5.git) with two changes: avfilter stays on (qtmultimedia-deinterlace.patch), and the ffmpeg and ffprobe programs are built (--disable-ffplay instead of --disable-programs). The other lists add the options of Qt for that platform and the hardware encoders and ARIB captions of the released FFmpeg. A kit can name another set of these lists with ffmpeg_options: linux_arm64 is the linux set without libvpl (x86 only) and nvenc (no NVIDIA GPU on the target boards). parts lists the extra sources of each target; each part has the file with its license text. msvc builds zlib as a part (Qt gives its MSVC FFmpeg zlib too; other targets find the zlib of the system or of MinGW). mingw turns off iconv: MinGW 13.1 has only a static GNU libiconv, whose source the packages would have to offer too. No option in these lists may enable GPL or nonfree code; the build fails unless FFmpeg reports LGPL 2.1 or later. The gpl block below is the only exception. checks lists what the ffmpeg program of each target must report.

ffmpeg._mingw_licenses: The MinGW FFmpeg contains static libraries of MinGW 13.1 (the MinGW-w64 runtime, winpthreads, zlib, the GCC runtime). The GPL MinGW FFmpeg links the zlib part instead of the zlib of MinGW, so its recipe leaves out zlib/copying.txt. These files in <MinGW>/licenses/ have their license texts.
ffmpeg._gpl: The GPL FFmpeg: the Build FFmpeg workflow with license gpl builds it for the kits in gpl.release, and releases it on its own. No Qt kit contains it: the kits use the LGPL FFmpeg, and qtci.py setup-deps (the stage jobs) refuses a GPL recipe and a GPL FFmpeg. The recipe of a kit adds gpl.parts and gpl.configure to the lists above, and gpl.checks to its checks. --extra-libs=-lm: FFmpeg's configure checks libsoxr and libxvid (static, without .pc files) without libm. --enable-version3 makes it GPL 3 or later, which OpenSSL 3 (Linux) needs; the Apache-2.0 license of mbedtls (inside SRT) is also compatible with the GPL 3 only (mbedtls is Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later). The build fails unless FFmpeg reports GPL 3 or later. No option may enable nonfree code. Linux uses the FreeType of the system, which libaribcaption already links; the other targets build it. There is no msvc entry: the script builds the parts with autotools, meson, and CMake only, and xvid, Theora, and zimg have only Visual Studio projects for MSVC, and programs built with MSVC can use the MinGW DLLs. extra_licenses names more files of a part that the package must contain, for example its patent grant. mingw builds zlib as a part, as msvc does, and --enable-zlib stops the build if FFmpeg does not find it. So the source archive has the source of every library that the GPL FFmpeg links statically, except the runtime libraries of the compiler (System Libraries, GPL v3 section 1): those of MinGW, and the C++ runtime of the Android NDK.

estimates._comment: Minutes for one item on a 4-core runner, Release only. Each kit multiplies these by its estimate_factor.

msvc2022_64._module_installs: Like installs of a module, for this kit only. The OpenSSL TLS backend: without OpenSSL, configure leaves it out without an error.

mingw1310_64._comment: From opensource-qtmake6120-mingw-1310.bat. The configure options go to qtbase; modules inherit the build type and the debug-info features.
mingw1310_64._module_installs: Like installs of a module, for this kit only. The OpenSSL TLS backend: without OpenSSL, configure leaves it out without an error.

android_arm64_v8a._module_installs: Like installs of a module, for this kit only. The OpenSSL TLS backend: without OpenSSL, configure leaves it out without an error.

gcc_64._comment: From 6.11.1/qtmake6.sh, not yet tried locally with 6.12.0.
gcc_64._module_installs: Like installs of a module, for this kit only. The OpenSSL TLS backend: without OpenSSL, configure leaves it out without an error.

gcc_arm64._comment: Linux arm64, built in a Debian 12 (bookworm) container, so that the kit links the Debian 12 libraries (glibc 2.36, ICU 72) of Raspberry Pi OS (Legacy, 64-bit) based on Debian 12. It does not run on Ubuntu 24.04 or on the Raspberry Pi OS based on Debian 13. No docs and no FEATURE_clang: the arm64 libclang of Qt is not set up for this kit yet. Precompiled headers are off, because they need much memory on a 4-core runner. QtWebEngine needs a QTCI_RUNNER_WEBENGINE_GCC_ARM64 runner that runs Debian 12 on arm64 itself ("arch"), because the webengine job does not run in the container.
gcc_arm64.docs_unavailable: qdoc needs libclang, and the arm64 libclang of Qt is not set up for this kit yet
gcc_arm64._module_installs: Like installs of a module, for this kit only. The OpenSSL TLS backend: without OpenSSL, configure leaves it out without an error.

gcc_arm64_ubuntu._comment: Linux arm64 for Ubuntu 24.04: the same configuration as gcc_arm64, but built directly on the ubuntu-24.04-arm runner, without a container, so that the kit links the Ubuntu 24.04 libraries (glibc 2.39, ICU 74). It does not run on Debian 12; use gcc_arm64 there. No docs and no FEATURE_clang: the arm64 libclang of Qt is not set up for this kit yet. Precompiled headers are off, because they need much memory on a 4-core runner. QtWebEngine needs a QTCI_RUNNER_WEBENGINE_GCC_ARM64_UBUNTU runner, an Ubuntu 24.04 machine on arm64 ("system" and "arch" are checked by every stage job).
gcc_arm64_ubuntu.docs_unavailable: qdoc needs libclang, and the arm64 libclang of Qt is not set up for this kit yet
gcc_arm64_ubuntu._module_installs: Like installs of a module, for this kit only. The OpenSSL TLS backend: without OpenSSL, configure leaves it out without an error.

macos._comment: From 6.11.1/qtmake6-macos.sh (arm64 only), not yet tried locally with 6.12.0. libclang is added so that the docs can be built.
